items.summary: Articles: Zcash resists crypto market selloff as network upgrade goes live. What's next? US-Iran uncertainty keeps the downside in oil limited as markets await further developments Eurozone retail sales fall 0.7% in September, signalling weakening consumer demand Risk-off wave hits Bitcoin as tech stocks lead global selloff.
items.impactZh: 关键宏观数据超预期时，点差与滑点风险通常放大，建议降低仓位并控制杠杆。
items.impactEn: When macro data surprises, spread/slippage risk often widens; consider smaller position size and tighter leverage control.
items.summaryZh: 文章：随着网络升级上线， Zcash抵制加密市场抛售。接下来会发生什么？随着市场等待进一步发展， 9月份欧元区零售额下降0.7% ，美国-伊朗的不确定性使石油有限下行，这表明随着科技股引领全球抛售，消费者需求减弱，风险降低浪潮打击了比特币。
